chapters.title: Chapter 457 - The Best
paragraphs: First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City.
The hospital director brought along two subordinates to tentatively serve Ling Ran and his group.
He did not know Ling Ran or Professor Huang, but the hospital director of First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City had met An Ruide before, who was the person leading the group.
He could even guess An Ruide’s motives. However, if An Ruide did not mention it, he would just pretend to be ignorant.
Giving treatment to famous people was not always a good thing.
Although the stories of Bian Que and Hua Tuo were a tale, they kept repeating themselves in reality.
This was just as Zhang Xueliang said, “Without a good tool, don’t bother to do the work.”
An Ruide was carefully attending to Ling Ran.

Since this was a direct order from Mei Tiangui, he had to do it well no matter what. An Ruide was even more careful when he thought about the story behind this matter. If it were possible, An Ruide would want to carry Ling Ran to prevent him from injuring his hands while walking.

The hospital director of First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City briefly introduced the operating theaters and surgical devices in the hospital, along with the medical staff and so on. An Ruide then asked eagerly, “Doctor Ling, do you think the operating theater is suitable to be used? Is there anything that needs to be added or improved?”
“Looks good, it’s not too bad.” Ling Ran’s tone could be considered as a compliment.

Wuxin City was a big city whose size was second to Yun Hua City in Changxi Province. Although the city infrastructure, public finance-revenue, and so on were not as good as Yun Hua City, there were scenic areas that were famous in the area. The natural environment was beautiful, and there were also many permanent nursing homes there. So, as the local biggest and best hospital in the region, the hospital was constructed based on the standards of high-class tertiary Grade A hospitals.

Even though due to the agglomeration effect in Yun Hua city, the standards of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City could not be raised up, and it was always a step behind Yun Hua Hospital as well as the provincial hospital in all aspects, but the standard of its facilities were made based on Yun Hua Hospital. Besides, since it was built at a much later date, the facilities in the operating theaters were much better and had overtaken Yun Hua Hospital.

Nowadays, Ling Ran had to go for freelance surgery at least once or twice every month. At most, he would need to perform freelance surgeries thrice a month. The operating theaters he saw in all those surgeries were operating theaters built by junior hospitals. For him, the operating theater of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City could be considered to be in very good condition.

However, An Ruide was not satisfied with that. He shook his head and said, “Quite good and up to standard is never good enough. I think we should work more on this. We might not be able to be the best, but we should be among the leading hospitals in terms of facilities, right?”

Ling Ran glanced at him doubtfully and said, “Based on your current condition, it’s impossible for your hospital to build a better operating theater. Also, what’s the standard for a leading operating theater?”

An Ruide was stunned speechless. He finally understood Ling Ran’s style. Then, he coughed and said, “Doctor Ling, what I meant was, the operating theater should at least be made according to the standard of the top quality operating theaters in the country. We can’t be glaringly worse than the other operating theaters in other places. It’ll be best if we have something about us that stands out. We don’t seek to be the best, but at least, we should not be lousy. At the very least, all our indices should be ranked above average when it comes to the quality of the operating theaters in the country.”

“If you’re comparing your operating theaters with the average standard of the operating theaters in the country...” Ling Ran looked around and said, “This operating theater meets the requirement. Not only is it above average, but from what I know, it should be higher than the median.”
“I’m not talking about this sort of average...” An Ruide thought about it and said, “Why don’t you try to give it marks?”
Professor Huang immediately stopped him. “Hospitals can’t be given marks this way. That’s different...”
‘If the mark is given, we’ll end up thoroughly offending the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City?’ Professor Huang wiped his sweat secretly and felt as though he had just avoided a disaster.
“Then, just follow the standards of Yun Hua Hospital. What do you all think?” An Ruide at least wanted to prove that he had used up every method to make his operating theaters good.

Professor Huang was still the first to speak, “Department Director An, the level of the hospital cannot be merely judged by the infrastructure only. If you were to talk about the infrastructure, then what about Peking Union Medical College Hospital? They’re still using the buildings made using red bricks that are built in the 30s. They’re already very worn down, but they still treated so many patients...”
“But a good operating theater would be better than a lousy one, right?” An Ruide gave an undeniable argument.
Professor Huang could only nod in agreement to that.
An Ruide looked at Ling Ran.
Naturally, Ling Ran agreed with it too.

“Then, let us think together so that we can figure out how we can increase the level of this operating theater and make it one of the top operating theaters in the country, perhaps even making it achieve the highest standards.” An Ruide’s expression was extremely serious.
Ling Ran glanced at An Ruide strangely. He said, “In order to reach the highest standard, won’t you need to go to Beijing?”
The people from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City almost laughed when they heard that. They immediately lowered their heads.

An Ruide frowned. “The natural environment in Wuxin City is good. The elderly are used to this lifestyle. Isn’t it normal if they refused to leave? Let us not think too much. If you must put it that way, the conditions in foreign countries are even better, but is everyone supposed to fly to foreign countries for treatment? Let us now think about the qualifications of Wuxin City. Is there any room for improvement, and how can we make it better?”
This excuse was definitely not sufficient, but he had at least given some reasons.
The hospital director of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City said politely, “If you want to make it better, maybe we need to upgrade some devices...”
“Doctor Ling, what do you think?” An Ruide asked.
“It will be great to have new devices.” Ling Ran stopped a while before he said, “But upgrading the devices and the time required for troubleshooting will be quite long.”
“Troubleshooting?”

“When new devices have just been used, there’s a possibility that all sorts of problems will arise, the settings for the parameters may not be good enough too, and it might not work as well as the previous device. So, they require some time for troubleshooting and testing,” Professor Huang explained.
“That means that after the installation of the new devices, we will have to let them run for some time first?” An Ruide asked.
Professor Huang said slowly, “That’s basically it. Usually, it will be the best for a new device to be on a trial run for one or two years.”

“We don’t have time for a year or two years. I can only let you have one to two weeks’ time.” An Ruide became slightly fierce at this point, and he sounded as if he was voicing the Mei family’s concerns.
Ling Ran pursed his lips. “Then, it’ll be better if we just use the old devices.”
An Ruide was stunned for a while, and he could not refute that.
After some time, An Ruide smiled. “Doctor Ling, you’re the doctor. We’ll follow what you said. What do you think we should do?”

“We can still upgrade a few devices. If we are unable to perform troubleshooting in time, we can consider using the same model from Yun Hua Hospital, and let the people from Yun Hua Hospital come to make adjustments...” Ling Ran did not even think about the cost or efficiency. With just a few sentences, he made a few individuals from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City stare at each other at a loss.
Great attention needed to be given to the hospital’s devices.

That included medication. They were handled from the manufacturer to the agents. The agents would then enter a tender in the hospital, and lastly, have the medicine enter the hospital. Different hospitals might have different agents, so the arrangement of medicine and devices would be different. It was very difficult for a hospital to detach from their agents, which consisted of a group of pharmaceutical sales representatives, within a short period of time.

Even pharmaceutical sales companies with great capabilities would need to put in a lot of effort in order to get their medication into hospitals unless they were the only sellers of a certain medication.
What Ling Ran said was equal to replacing all devices in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City with those from Yun Hua Hospital.
If this happened in another place, a few people of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City would definitely oppose his suggestion strongly.
An Ruide could probably guess some of the secrets behind this, but for him, this was just a chance for him to prove his own strength.
“Then, we will use the devices of Yun Hua Hospital!” An Ruide made a firm decision.
“If that’s the case, I want to use some people from Yun Hua Hospital as well. The success rate will be higher if I operate with the team I’m familiar with,” Ling Ran said.
“Then, we’ll use people from Yun Hua Hospital.”
The hospital director of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City felt a bit angry but amused at the same time. “In that case, why don’t you just perform the surgery at Yun Hua Hospital?”
“You want us to drive 249 miles?” An Ruide stared at the hospital director, and he said, “Are you joking?”
The hospital director thought secretly. ‘There are many patients who seek a doctor a thousand miles away. 249 miles is nothing.’
Unfortunately, An Ruide was an unreasonable person. The hospital director could only apologize and said, “I misunderstood things.”
“Okay.” An Ruide thought about it and said, “Even if it is your team, Doctor Ling, please try to perform a few more surgeries in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City.”
“No problem.” Ling Ran agreed immediately.

They will definitely be using the hospital beds of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City if he performed surgeries in their hospital. Since Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center was running out of hospital beds, this was a great benefit.
An Ruide was quite happy. Ling Ran’s swift answer that was given without any hesitation made his work much easier.
“There is another problem,” Ling Ran said while An Ruide was smiling.
An Ruide immediately hid his smile. “Problem?”
“The patient is too plump. Please make him cut down his weight,” Ling Ran said.
“Cut... cut down his weight?”

An Ruide could not help but laugh. “Doctor Ling, do you know... how hard it is for him to cut down his weight? If he can cut it, don’t you think he’d have reduced his weight much earlier?”

Ling Ran nodded. “There is nothing we can do if he can’t lose some weight. But a plump person has a higher death rate and worse prognosis. Please pass this message to him. Before the surgery, I’ll explain it clearly to him too.”
An Ruide wanted to retort, but he calmed himself down.
The life of his leader and the habits of his leader... which one was more important? This was a question that required thought.

sentences.text: First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City.
The hospital director brought along two subordinates to tentatively serve Ling Ran and his group.
He did not know Ling Ran or Professor Huang, but the hospital director of First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City had met An Ruide before, who was the person leading the group.
He could even guess An Ruide’s motives.
However, if An Ruide did not mention it, he would just pretend to be ignorant.
Giving treatment to famous people was not always a good thing.
Although the stories of Bian Que and Hua Tuo were a tale, they kept repeating themselves in reality.
This was just as Zhang Xueliang said, “Without a good tool, don’t bother to do the work.”
An Ruide was carefully attending to Ling Ran.
Since this was a direct order from Mei Tiangui, he had to do it well no matter what.
An Ruide was even more careful when he thought about the story behind this matter.
If it were possible, An Ruide would want to carry Ling Ran to prevent him from injuring his hands while walking.
The hospital director of First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City briefly introduced the operating theaters and surgical devices in the hospital, along with the medical staff and so on.
An Ruide then asked eagerly, “Doctor Ling, do you think the operating theater is suitable to be used?
Is there anything that needs to be added or improved?”
“Looks good, it’s not too bad.” Ling Ran’s tone could be considered as a compliment.
Wuxin City was a big city whose size was second to Yun Hua City in Changxi Province.
Although the city infrastructure, public finance-revenue, and so on were not as good as Yun Hua City, there were scenic areas that were famous in the area.
The natural environment was beautiful, and there were also many permanent nursing homes there.
So, as the local biggest and best hospital in the region, the hospital was constructed based on the standards of high-class tertiary Grade A hospitals.

Even though due to the agglomeration effect in Yun Hua city, the standards of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City could not be raised up, and it was always a step behind Yun Hua Hospital as well as the provincial hospital in all aspects, but the standard of its facilities were made based on Yun Hua Hospital.
Besides, since it was built at a much later date, the facilities in the operating theaters were much better and had overtaken Yun Hua Hospital.
Nowadays, Ling Ran had to go for freelance surgery at least once or twice every month.
At most, he would need to perform freelance surgeries thrice a month.
The operating theaters he saw in all those surgeries were operating theaters built by junior hospitals.
For him, the operating theater of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City could be considered to be in very good condition.
However, An Ruide was not satisfied with that.
He shook his head and said, “Quite good and up to standard is never good enough.
I think we should work more on this.
We might not be able to be the best, but we should be among the leading hospitals in terms of facilities, right?”
Ling Ran glanced at him doubtfully and said, “Based on your current condition, it’s impossible for your hospital to build a better operating theater.
Also, what’s the standard for a leading operating theater?”
An Ruide was stunned speechless.
He finally understood Ling Ran’s style.
Then, he coughed and said, “Doctor Ling, what I meant was, the operating theater should at least be made according to the standard of the top quality operating theaters in the country.
We can’t be glaringly worse than the other operating theaters in other places.
It’ll be best if we have something about us that stands out.
We don’t seek to be the best, but at least, we should not be lousy.
At the very least, all our indices should be ranked above average when it comes to the quality of the operating theaters in the country.”
“If you’re comparing your operating theaters with the average standard of the operating theaters in the country...” Ling Ran looked around and said, “This operating theater meets the requirement.
Not only is it above average, but from what I know, it should be higher than the median.”
“I’m not talking about this sort of average...” An Ruide thought about it and said, “Why don’t you try to give it marks?”
Professor Huang immediately stopped him.
“Hospitals can’t be given marks this way.
That’s different...”
‘If the mark is given, we’ll end up thoroughly offending the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City?’ Professor Huang wiped his sweat secretly and felt as though he had just avoided a disaster.
“Then, just follow the standards of Yun Hua Hospital.
What do you all think?” An Ruide at least wanted to prove that he had used up every method to make his operating theaters good.
Professor Huang was still the first to speak, “Department Director An, the level of the hospital cannot be merely judged by the infrastructure only.
If you were to talk about the infrastructure, then what about Peking Union Medical College Hospital?
They’re still using the buildings made using red bricks that are built in the 30s.
They’re already very worn down, but they still treated so many patients...”
“But a good operating theater would be better than a lousy one, right?” An Ruide gave an undeniable argument.
Professor Huang could only nod in agreement to that.
An Ruide looked at Ling Ran.
Naturally, Ling Ran agreed with it too.

“Then, let us think together so that we can figure out how we can increase the level of this operating theater and make it one of the top operating theaters in the country, perhaps even making it achieve the highest standards.” An Ruide’s expression was extremely serious.
Ling Ran glanced at An Ruide strangely.
He said, “In order to reach the highest standard, won’t you need to go to Beijing?”
The people from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City almost laughed when they heard that.
They immediately lowered their heads.
An Ruide frowned.
“The natural environment in Wuxin City is good.
The elderly are used to this lifestyle.
Isn’t it normal if they refused to leave?
Let us not think too much.
If you must put it that way, the conditions in foreign countries are even better, but is everyone supposed to fly to foreign countries for treatment?
Let us now think about the qualifications of Wuxin City.
Is there any room for improvement, and how can we make it better?”
This excuse was definitely not sufficient, but he had at least given some reasons.
The hospital director of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City said politely, “If you want to make it better, maybe we need to upgrade some devices...”
“Doctor Ling, what do you think?” An Ruide asked.
“It will be great to have new devices.” Ling Ran stopped a while before he said, “But upgrading the devices and the time required for troubleshooting will be quite long.”
“Troubleshooting?”

“When new devices have just been used, there’s a possibility that all sorts of problems will arise, the settings for the parameters may not be good enough too, and it might not work as well as the previous device.
So, they require some time for troubleshooting and testing,” Professor Huang explained.
“That means that after the installation of the new devices, we will have to let them run for some time first?” An Ruide asked.
Professor Huang said slowly, “That’s basically it.
Usually, it will be the best for a new device to be on a trial run for one or two years.”
“We don’t have time for a year or two years.
I can only let you have one to two weeks’ time.” An Ruide became slightly fierce at this point, and he sounded as if he was voicing the Mei family’s concerns.
Ling Ran pursed his lips.
“Then, it’ll be better if we just use the old devices.”
An Ruide was stunned for a while, and he could not refute that.
After some time, An Ruide smiled.
“Doctor Ling, you’re the doctor.
We’ll follow what you said.
What do you think we should do?”
“We can still upgrade a few devices.

If we are unable to perform troubleshooting in time, we can consider using the same model from Yun Hua Hospital, and let the people from Yun Hua Hospital come to make adjustments...” Ling Ran did not even think about the cost or efficiency.
With just a few sentences, he made a few individuals from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City stare at each other at a loss.
Great attention needed to be given to the hospital’s devices.
That included medication.
They were handled from the manufacturer to the agents.
The agents would then enter a tender in the hospital, and lastly, have the medicine enter the hospital.
Different hospitals might have different agents, so the arrangement of medicine and devices would be different.
It was very difficult for a hospital to detach from their agents, which consisted of a group of pharmaceutical sales representatives, within a short period of time.

What Ling Ran said was equal to replacing all devices in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City with those from Yun Hua Hospital.

An Ruide could probably guess some of the secrets behind this, but for him, this was just a chance for him to prove his own strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - Staying Awake for the Whole Night
paragraphs: “Doctor Ling, do you want to rest for a while?” The department director of the General Surgery Department of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City, Lu Yongmian tried his best to stay awake as he walked behind Ling Ran like a ghoul. He was even supporting himself by rubbing his shoulder against the wall.

Even though Ling Ran had already consumed three bottles of Energy Serum, he was also slightly tired. He took the stack of medical records from Lu Wenbin, who just woke up for his shift, and said as he flipped through the medical records, “I’ll operate on one more patient before I drink some tea and get some rest. Why don’t you go and sleep first?”

“Doctor Ling.” Lu Yongmian seemed to be using up every remaining ounce of energy in his body as he grabbed Ling Ran’s arm. “You can’t be carrying out any more surgeries. Get some rest first. You’ve been at it for... forty hours, I think.”

“Thirty-eight hours. It’s still far from forty hours.” Ling Ran did not even need to look at the clock to know the time. He drank a bottle of Energy Serum every ten hours as he felt that the effect of the Energy Serum could be maximized this way. This also enabled him to carry out surgeries at top-notch condition. Since he would need to operate on one more patient before it was time to drink another bottle of Energy Serum, it meant that he had been carrying out surgeries for thirty-eight hours.

However, Lu Yongmian could no longer take it. Ordinary people would start feeling dizzy after staying awake for the whole night to work for twenty continuous hours, and they would practically become zombified after doing so for thirty continuous hours. Most doctors were able to work continuously for thirty or even thirty-six hours because they secretly took naps in between. Even if they only got to catch fragments of sleep that only lasted for a few hours, they would feel a lot more refreshed.

Of course, there were times when the hospitals were so flooded with patients that the doctors did not get the chance to sleep at all. That was when they would have to bite the bullet and stay awake for thirty or even thirty-six hours. However, this was already the upper limit, especially for a department director of the General Surgery Department like Lu Yongmian. It had been a few years since he stayed awake for the entire night to work for thirty-six continuous hours, and even then, he secretly caught brief naps in between.
He could not believe his eyes when he saw that Ling Ran carried out surgery after surgery for almost forty continuous hours.

Of course, the media had reported about surgery maniacs who could perform surgeries for more than thirty continuous hours. However, the fact that they made the news meant that they were in the minority.
Lu Yongmian did not know how many doctors had been forced to carry out surgeries for more than thirty, or even forty continuous hours.
But was the situation right now so dire that Ling Ran needed to operate for such a long time?
Besides, Ling Ran obviously looked like he was having a lot of fun.

“Doctor Ling, you... did you take some kind of pill?” Lu Yongmian was already in a daze. If he had been in a proper state of mind, which meant that he had only stayed awake for less than twenty hours, he would not have asked such a question.
It was not a strange occurrence for doctors to consume strange drugs.

Anesthetists were always the ones who frequently got into trouble for eating forbidden drugs. There were many surgeons who could not resist trying to outsmart drugs in order to enhance their performance when carrying out surgeries, writing research papers, studying for exams, attending dinners, and participating in meetings with the leaders.
As Lu Yongmian gazed at Ling Ran, he truly suspected that Ling Ran had taken some sort of smart drug.

Lu Wenbin who just woke up and was full of energy was in a clear state of mind. He immediately stood between them and said, “Department Director Lu, is your brain functioning properly? The fact that Doctor Ling carried out surgeries for so many continuous hours doesn’t mean that there’s something wrong with him. Is this how a department director should be acting?”

“I’m not really considered a leader.” Lu Yongmian regained some of his senses when he heard that and chuckled a few times. He then supported himself by resting his palm against the wall, and slowly plopped onto the floor. “Sigh, I really can’t take it anymore. Doctor Ling, we’re not in a rush, anyway. Why don’t we take the night off and continue tomorrow?”

He was tasked to accompany Ling Ran as Ling Ran carried out surgeries while making arrangements and coordinating with other parties on Ling Ran’s behalf. Aside from this, he was also supposed to keep a watch on Ling Ran to prevent anything unexpected from happening.
Those from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City meant well. They just did not expect that Ling Ran to be able to work for so many continuous hours.

When Ling Ran saw what a sorry figure Lu Yongmian cut as he sat on the floor, he hesitated for a moment and said, “Then, I’ll just operate on one last patient before taking a rest. You can go ahead and rest first. Do ask the hospital to send someone else to accompany me tomorrow.
Lu Yongmian was extremely satisfied with this arrangement. He nodded furiously and said, “I’ll do that right now. I’ll notify you when I find someone to replace me.”

“Alright, I’ll enter the operating theater first, then,” Ling Ran said politely and headed to the sink to wash his hands. After he took a few steps, he stopped in his tracks and said to Lu Yongmian, “Do make the arrangement right now, as it would be the best if you can get someone to accompany me by tomorrow. We should try to avoid all delays.”

Surgeries that are not branches of main surgeries were known internally in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City as “important surgeries”, and Lu Yongmian did not dare to cause any delay. He stared after Ling Ran as Ling Ran entered the operating theater before whipping out his phone and sending a few text messages.

Ling Ran happily performed another hepatectomy before sending the patient to the ICU of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City. He then said to the ordinary-looking associate chief physician, who was newly appointed by the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City to accompany Ling Ran, “I’ll sleep for four hours. Do get ready for tomorrow’s surgeries.”

“Four hours? Alright.” The associate chief physician chuckled a few times. After he walked Ling Ran to the on-call room, he said to the resident doctors standing outside the room, “All of you can go ahead and rest. Ling Ran has not slept for forty hours, and I’m pretty sure he will need at least twenty hours of sleep.”
After he said that, the associate chief physician who was ordinary in terms of looks, work performance, intelligence quotient, and emotional intelligence went into another on-call room to sleep.
It was almost dawn, and everyone wanted a good night’s sleep.
Early in the morning.
The ordinary associate chief physician was roused from a deep sleep when someone knocked loudly on the door.
“Did you know that Ling Ran is carrying out surgeries already?” The hospital director’s gaze was so oppressive that it could kill four associate chief physicians and two hundred resident doctors.
The associate chief physician laughed. “It’s impossible. He just operated on patients for forty continuous hours.”
“Operating Theater 2.” The hospital director turned and left after he said that, not bothering to argue with the associate chief physician.

The associate chief physician still had a blanket wrapped around his body. He only managed to regain his senses after everyone who passed by looked scornfully at him. He quickly got changed and rushed to the operating theater.
Ling Ran was full of energy in Operating Theater 2
He was feeling extremely refreshed.

To ensure a good night’s sleep and more importantly, to make sure that the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City still had not noticed him using up their hospital beds, Ling Ran drank a bottle of Energy Serum before going to sleep.
Technically, he could immediately regain all his strength after consuming a bottle of Energy Serum.

It was just that Ling Ran did not have that much trust in the efficiency of the Energy Serum, which was an uncertified drug. This was why he took a brief rest after consuming the fourth bottle of Energy Serum.
To him, it was just like having some English tea and getting some rest.

In other words, Ling Ran slept for four hours even though he was full of energy. At this moment, it was as if Ling Ran had slept for an unlimited period of time without an alarm clock. He was pumped so full of energy that he could not wait to let out.
“Scalpel!
“Endotherm knife!
“Forceps!”
Ling Ran spoke extremely quickly, as he was also operating on the patient at an extremely rapid speed.
He could not help it; he was extremely familiar with what he was doing.

The doctors of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City utilized their personal connections and gathered a large number of patients suffering from hepatolithiasis. They used clinical research as an excuse to invite those patients over to receive surgery in their hospital. This trick was often used by major hospitals.

The doctors of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were indeed preparing to carry out research regarding hepatolithiasis and had formed a specialized team for this. Even though Ling Ran bought his own team, the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City also prepared a backup team. And as it seemed, they made the right decision.

It only took Ling Ran one day to tire the members of his own team out. This was especially true when it came to the two young nurses, Wang Jia, and Su Mengxue. It was impossible for them to work such long hours without making any mistakes.

As Ling Ran possessed Master Level Hepatectomy, performing hepatectomy on patients suffering from hepatolithiasis was relatively easy for him to begin with. Now that he was continuously carrying out surgeries of the same nature, he was more than used to it. During the surgery, he could also make judgments at lightning speed.

“I’m done. Send the patient to the ICU. Give him critical care, and pay attention to his blood pressure...” After Ling Ran completed the surgery, he gave medical advice while he was at it. He could be said to have talked about one-third of what the doctors in the ICU needed to do.

The doctors from the ICU of Yun Hu Hospital were often unwilling to take Ling Ran’s advice. Since the doctors from the ICU of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City had their jobs at stake, they had no choice but to listen to Ling Ran. This made Ling Ran very happy.
Since the surgery went smoothly and the patient had a good prognosis, the patient and his family members were also very happy.

The doctors of the General Surgery Department of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were the only ones who did not share this joy. As the days passed by, and they got to watch Ling Ran carry out more and more surgeries, they started becoming silent.
Many people worked hard because they had not seen the abilities of truly excellent people. After they witnessed that, they would lose the driving force to better themselves.
On the Monday of the following week, the ICU of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City officially ran out of hospital beds.
Even though patients left the ICU one after another, other departments would also send patients to the ICU. It was no longer possible for Ling Ran to carry out surgeries nonstop.

“Give Mei Tiangui a call. I’m ready to operate on him.” Ling Ran was a little despondent as he spoke to Professor Huang on the phone. “He can either become my second or third patient tomorrow. Let’s leave the choice up to them.”
Since some patients would be transferred out of the ICU tomorrow, Ling Ran was striving to operate on two more patients.
Professor Huang was a little hesitant. “Are you also operating on other patients tomorrow?”

Ling Ran thought about the way people from the Mei family acted and said, “Let’s just leave the choice up to them. Tell them that I’m thinking about operating on one or two patients before operating on Elder Mei. If they insist on me operating on Elder Mei first thing in the morning, I have no problem with that either.”
Professor Huang could not help but laugh out loud. “Alright, let’s leave the choice up to them, then.”

From the perspective of outsiders, surgeons were supposed to be the most refreshed and energetic when operating on their first patient of the day. However, outsiders might also believe that surgeons’ hands were more nimble by the time they carried out their second surgery of the day, and hence could do a better job.

“Did you know that Ling Ran is carrying out surgeries already?” The hospital director’s gaze was so oppressive that it could kill four associate chief physicians and two hundred resident doctors.
The associate chief physician laughed.
“It’s impossible.
He just operated on patients for forty continuous hours.”
“Operating Theater 2.” The hospital director turned and left after he said that, not bothering to argue with the associate chief physician.
The associate chief physician still had a blanket wrapped around his body.
He only managed to regain his senses after everyone who passed by looked scornfully at him.
He quickly got changed and rushed to the operating theater.
Ling Ran was full of energy in Operating Theater 2
He was feeling extremely refreshed.

To ensure a good night’s sleep and more importantly, to make sure that the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City still had not noticed him using up their hospital beds, Ling Ran drank a bottle of Energy Serum before going to sleep.
Technically, he could immediately regain all his strength after consuming a bottle of Energy Serum.
It was just that Ling Ran did not have that much trust in the efficiency of the Energy Serum, which was an uncertified drug.
This was why he took a brief rest after consuming the fourth bottle of Energy Serum.
To him, it was just like having some English tea and getting some rest.
In other words, Ling Ran slept for four hours even though he was full of energy.
At this moment, it was as if Ling Ran had slept for an unlimited period of time without an alarm clock.
He was pumped so full of energy that he could not wait to let out.
“Scalpel!
“Endotherm knife!
“Forceps!”
Ling Ran spoke extremely quickly, as he was also operating on the patient at an extremely rapid speed.
He could not help it; he was extremely familiar with what he was doing.
The doctors of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City utilized their personal connections and gathered a large number of patients suffering from hepatolithiasis.
They used clinical research as an excuse to invite those patients over to receive surgery in their hospital.
This trick was often used by major hospitals.
The doctors of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were indeed preparing to carry out research regarding hepatolithiasis and had formed a specialized team for this.
Even though Ling Ran bought his own team, the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City also prepared a backup team.
And as it seemed, they made the right decision.
It only took Ling Ran one day to tire the members of his own team out.
This was especially true when it came to the two young nurses, Wang Jia, and Su Mengxue.
It was impossible for them to work such long hours without making any mistakes.
As Ling Ran possessed Master Level Hepatectomy, performing hepatectomy on patients suffering from hepatolithiasis was relatively easy for him to begin with.
Now that he was continuously carrying out surgeries of the same nature, he was more than used to it.
During the surgery, he could also make judgments at lightning speed.
“I’m done.
Send the patient to the ICU.
Give him critical care, and pay attention to his blood pressure...” After Ling Ran completed the surgery, he gave medical advice while he was at it.
He could be said to have talked about one-third of what the doctors in the ICU needed to do.
The doctors from the ICU of Yun Hu Hospital were often unwilling to take Ling Ran’s advice.
Since the doctors from the ICU of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City had their jobs at stake, they had no choice but to listen to Ling Ran.
This made Ling Ran very happy.
Since the surgery went smoothly and the patient had a good prognosis, the patient and his family members were also very happy.
The doctors of the General Surgery Department of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City were the only ones who did not share this joy.
As the days passed by, and they got to watch Ling Ran carry out more and more surgeries, they started becoming silent.
Many people worked hard because they had not seen the abilities of truly excellent people.
After they witnessed that, they would lose the driving force to better themselves.
On the Monday of the following week, the ICU of the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City officially ran out of hospital beds.
Even though patients left the ICU one after another, other departments would also send patients to the ICU.
It was no longer possible for Ling Ran to carry out surgeries nonstop.
“Give Mei Tiangui a call.
I’m ready to operate on him.” Ling Ran was a little despondent as he spoke to Professor Huang on the phone.
“He can either become my second or third patient tomorrow.
Let’s leave the choice up to them.”
Since some patients would be transferred out of the ICU tomorrow, Ling Ran was striving to operate on two more patients.
Professor Huang was a little hesitant.
“Are you also operating on other patients tomorrow?”
Ling Ran thought about the way people from the Mei family acted and said, “Let’s just leave the choice up to them.
Tell them that I’m thinking about operating on one or two patients before operating on Elder Mei.
If they insist on me operating on Elder Mei first thing in the morning, I have no problem with that either.”
Professor Huang could not help but laugh out loud.
“Alright, let’s leave the choice up to them, then.”
From the perspective of outsiders, surgeons were supposed to be the most refreshed and energetic when operating on their first patient of the day.
However, outsiders might also believe that surgeons’ hands were more nimble by the time they carried out their second surgery of the day, and hence could do a better job.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - Working Early in the Morning
paragraphs: Wuxin City had always been renowned for its beautiful scenery.
Half of the national AAAAA level[1] scenic spots within Changxi province were located in Wuxin City.

Ever since the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City was first constructed, those involved had placed a lot of emphasis on the aesthetics of the buildings and surrounding plants. The plaza in front of the hospital itself had almost a hundred types of plants, causing plenty of patients to develop allergies every year.

Elder Mei traveled to the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City by car, and he was unwilling to be in a wheelchair no matter what. He supported himself with his walking stick as he walked at a snail’s pace toward the entrance of the hospital.
Now that the hospital director and the others who were welcoming Elder Mei at the entrance saw him in real life, all of them straightened their backs.
“I’m just suffering from a minor illness. There’s no need for so many of you to be here.” Elder Mei was born with a fierce countenance. Or rather, he developed it after scolding a lot of people.
The hospital director and the other people quickly flashed a bright smile. They looked as obedient and brilliant as wintersweet.
“Doctor Ling.” Elder Mei did not have any intention of greeting those who had come out to welcome him. When he turned and saw Ling Ran, he totally ignored the rest of them.
“Elder Mei.” Ling Ran sized Elder Mei up from top to toe. He looked at his fleshy shoulders, fleshy chest, and large belly in the process. He then asked, “How many pounds have you lost?”
“Sixteen pounds!” Elder Mei raised his chin proudly and finally flashed a smile. “I’m already nearly eighty years old, and my legs are no longer working well. Losing weight was seriously tough.”
Ling Ran inspected Elder Mei a little suspiciously using the visual inspection method, which was part of the physical examination process. He then shook his head. “That’s impossible.”
“How is it impossible!?” Elder Mei got annoyed. “Why would I lie to you?”
The hospital director and the others quickly lowered their heads. They could not really stand the sight of a senior citizen throwing a tantrum.
Elder Mei’s oldest daughter was also rather embarrassed by her father’s antics. She grabbed her father by the arm and said, “Dad, let’s go in. It’s very chilly outside, and you could catch a cold.”
“Okay.” Elder Mei was also feeling a little diffident. With a sway of his fleshy butt, he turned and entered the hospital.
His gait was extremely authoritative, as though he had specially practiced it before. If it were not for the fact that he possessed such a large belly, he would have seemed rather agile.
The crowd immediately followed him.

Professor Huang breathed a sigh of relief. He pulled Ling Ran over and spoke to him as they walked at the back of the crowd, “You should put things a little more mildly. Elder Mei has always been the type of person who means what he says. Don’t end up in trouble while you treat a patient.”
“He’d be the only one who’s at a disadvantage if he didn’t lose weight,” Ling Ran said.

“Yes, he knows that too. Besides, even if he didn’t lose eighteen pounds, he must have lost at least thirteen pounds. It’s not easy to lose thirteen pounds either. Take a look at me. I’ve been trying to lose weight for three or four years, but I’m still as fat as a pig.”
Ling Ran looked at Professor Huang like he was looking at a pig before flashing him a socially appropriate smile.

Professor Huang did not know whether to laugh or cry. He shook his head and said, “No matter what, watch your words. The opportunity to treat Elder Mei is hard to come by. Other old cadres would have opted to head to Beijing or Shanghai for treatment.”
“Why didn’t he go to those places then?”

Even if a person were to select a middle-class tertiary Grade A hospital from Beijing at random, that hospital would be more well-equipped than the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City. This was especially true when it came to doctors, because there were way too many excellent doctors in Beijing.

Professor Huang smiled and said, “I’ve heard some rumors, and I have no idea which ones are true and which ones are false. Whatever it is, since he’s here for treatment, you have to try your best to nurse him back to health, all right?”
“Sure.” Ling Ran agreed with that.

“Elder Mei was the one who kickstarted the agricultural industry and the tourism industry in Wuxin City many years ago. A few of the large drains and dams as well as intertidal zones in Changxi Province were also built under Elder Mei’s supervision. All the older farmers right now still remember how good Elder Mei was as a leader.” Professor Huang chuckled and continued, “Elder Mei himself loves food very much, and even founded a food magazine many years ago. He was willing to lose weight after you asked him to, and it must have been hard on him too.”
“Hmm... with his body constitution, he has to reduce his food consumption in order to lose weight easily,” Ling Ran concluded after he listened to what Professor Huang said.
After Professor Huang stared at Ling Ran for a few seconds, he gave up on trying to correct Ling Ran.
The hospital was in a flurry of motion the moment Elder Mei arrived. Firstly, Elder Mei had to undergo all kinds of tests.
No matter how many medical staff a hospital had, in the end, there was a limit on the number of tests that could be done on the same person at one time.
Even though everyone in the hospital tried their best to speed things up, the tests lasted until late at night.
There were just way too many tests that had to be carried out.
If Professor Huang had not been present, the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City would have probably let Elder Mei undergo every single test the hospital had to offer.
While Elder Mei was undergoing tests, his oldest son, Mei Tiangui got worried again. Hence, he gathered plenty of doctors and held a pointless consultation.
Zuo Cidian felt extremely uneasy as he sat next to Ling Ran. He advised Ling Ran in a hushed tone, “Doctor Ling, you must not act wilfully.”
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgement and nodded.
“No matter what they say, we can only discuss whether certain objective conditions can be achieved. You must remember that.”
“Okay.”
“Doctor Ling, even if they’re being rude, we must not fly into rage, don’t you agree?”
“I do,” Ling Ran answered in a level-headed manner.
However, the more obedient Ling Ran sounded, the more worried Zuo Cidian became.
When Zuo Cidian saw that there was no one around them, he asked in a hushed tone, “Doctor Ling, what do you think? Why don’t you tell me?”
“What are you talking about?” Ling Ran asked Zuo Cidian.
Zuo Cidian panicked internally and quickly said, “The Mei family members’ attitude. What’s your opinion on them? Let’s discuss this privately, all right? Don’t raise your voice, just whisper to me.”
Ling Ran thought about it and shook his head. “I don’t have any opinions on them.”
“Huh, you don’t?”

“We come across this type of family members all the time, don’t we? Especially those of patients who suffer from serious illnesses,” Ling Ran said, showing that he had a different opinion from Zuo Cidian.
Zuo Cidian was stunned when he heard that. “All the time? How is it possible? It’s the Mei family we’re talking about.”

Ling Ran nodded. “It’s only because they’re the family members of a powerful and influential patient. Don’t you guys secretly rank the patients and their family members according to how difficult they are to deal with? If you don’t take the Mei family’s power and influence into account, they’re not more difficult to deal with compared to the others, are they?”
“Hm... you’re right.” Zuo Cidian glanced at Ling Ran and said, “I didn’t expect you to see things from such a simple perspective.”
“Yes.” Ling Ran nodded. He then rose and said, “So, I’ll leave the rest to you. Don’t forget to ask the patient’s family members to sign the informed consent forms.”
After he said that, Ling Ran left.
*Creak.*
The shrill sound of a chair being pushed backward rang out.
Mei Tiangui raised his head in shock and noticed that the chief surgeon was the one who was leaving.
“Doctor Ling...” Mei Tiangui furrowed his eyebrows.

“Your father’s surgery is scheduled for seven in the morning tomorrow. We have already decided on a surgical plan. Since I still have a lot of preparation work to do, I’ll be taking my leave first.” As if he was dealing with family members of an ordinary patient, Ling Ran nodded slightly, turned, and left.
Mei Tiangui could not help but stand up, but all he did was stare after Ling Ran as Ling Ran walked away.

The data of all the hepatectomies Ling Ran had performed throughout his time in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City had been gathered and passed to the members of the Mei family. Even though they were still considering the possibility of enlisting the service of other chief surgeons a week or two ago, right now, they no longer had any other candidate in mind.
At four in the morning, Ling Ran walked quietly down one of the corridors in the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City with his team members.
Lu Wenbin, Yu Yuan, Zuo Cidian, and Ma Yanlin looked refreshed and alert as well.
They were already used to waking up at three in the morning to make ward rounds. As they got to sleep for an extra hour that day, all of them were feeling pretty good.
Suddenly, a gray figure flashed past the corner where the water cooler was located.
Ma Yanlin who was walking at the back of the group could not help but stop in his tracks. He hesitated before calling out, “Who’s there?”
The hospital corridor was extremely quiet at four in the morning.
“Who’s there?” After Ma Yanlin raised his head and looked at the others, he felt a little more at ease. He asked, “Did you guys see anyone?”
“There’s someone.” Ling Ran nodded firmly. He then turned and switched on the pantry lights.
In the corner, a rather flabby belly could be seen jutting out from behind the table.
Ling Ran waved.
Lu Wenbin, Yu Yuan, Zuo Cidian, and Ma Yanlin formed an arc as they stood behind Ling Ran.
Ling Ran whipped out a glove from his pocket, put it on, and poked the belly gently.
“It’s me!” The voice of its owner was majestic, and there was a hint of fierceness in his tone.
“Elder Mei?” Ling Ran asked.
Behind the table, the owner of the flabby belly sounded annoyed, but his voice was muffled. “It’s me! I’m just taking a walk.”
“It’s time to head to the operating theater.” Ling Ran furrowed his eyebrows.
“You guys go ahead. I’ll catch up later.”
Ling Ran laughed. He turned and said to Lu Wenbin, “Carry Elder Mei out of there.”
The belly behind the table rose and fell a few times. Elder Mei’s voice then rang out, “Wait... I’ll go out by myself.”
A few seconds later, Elder Mei placed his hand on the edge of the table to support himself as he wriggled out. His Adam’s apple even bobbed a few times.
This was Lu Wenbin, Yu Yuan, Zuo Cidian, and Ma Yanlin’s facial expression: O_O
“Did you eat something?” Ling Ran’s tone was solemn.
“No.” Elder Mei straightened his back as he supported himself with his hand on the edge of the table. He looked like an elegant, old, and fat cheetah with a large belly.
“You’re not allowed to eat before surgery,” Ling Ran said.
“I know, and I didn’t!” Elder Mei said authoritatively.
“There’s chocolate at the corners of your lips,” Ling Ran said.
Elder Mei stared fiercely at Ling Ran and slowly said, “It’s the cream filling from the waffle bar.”

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - Happy
paragraphs: The plump, fierce, and fleshy Elder Mei lay on the hospital bed. He looked serene and was covered with a long staple Egyptian cotton blanket brought by his daughter. He looked like a royal mummy being auctioned. Only the sagging flesh on his face was still as thick as ever, and it also made him look as fierce as ever. His stomach was still as big as ever, too.
Mei Tiangui always looked noble in front of others, and when he stood in front of his old father, he looked like a small kitten sitting at the feet of the Pharaoh’s throne.

The others were even more nervous. Only Elder Mei’s dumb little grandson babbled imcomprehensibly while he waved his plump hands, which looked like lotuses. It prevented the room from being filled with an awkward silence.

“In conclusion, delaying the surgery would be a better solution for the patient. Waiting for a little while more would be better for the patient’s prognosis.” Zuo Cidian could feel the beads of sweat forming in his armpits. He used to like giving speeches in meetings, but when he stood in front of the Mei family, Zuo Cidian found himself stuttering while enduring the stares from the Mei family’s iconic triangle eyes on their fierce and fleshy faces.
Mei Tiangui lowered his head and waited for Zuo Cidian to finish his speech. He shook his head subconsciously.

“According to current indications, you may drink a small amount of water and detox drinks up to two hours before surgery. You can eat a bit of digestible solid food six hours before surgery.” Doctor Jin, who was standing next to Mei Tiangui, said laboriously, “The operation time can be delayed within suitable limitations, but wouldn’t delaying it for twelve hours be a little too long?”

Professor Huang was Elder Mei’s doctor, and Doctor Jin was Mei Tiangui’s. He was even trusted by Mei Tiangui. The words he spoke at that moment was mainly to relieve the Mei family, especially the old man’s awkwardness. He was pretty much already very considerate.

In comparison, Ling Ran’s face was somewhat stiff, cold, carefree, suave, handsome, graceful, refined and elegant, refreshing and otherworldly, majestic and heroic, like bones that had been polished with a knife, and like jade that was wrought by chisel and stone...
Ling Ran said, “The patient ate solid food two hours before surgery.”
“Even so... there’s no need to delay for twelve hours...” Doctor Jin whispered, “It’ll be enough if you just delay it for six hours, or a maximum of eight hours.”
Right then, Elder Mei looked at Doctor Jin coldly and made the latter shudder violently.

Doctor Jin nervously added, “The time is too long. The patient will grow hungrier, and it won’t be conducive for postoperative recovery. Six hours is the limit. The current guidelines all recommend shortening the fasting time...”

“The patient is plump.” Ling Ran’s tone was rigid but warm, sonorous, pure, elegant, steady, and attractive. His words were spoken with clear articulation; they were melodious, and rhythmic. His voice was like gold, soothing to listen to, clear, and pleasant to the ears. It was just as Lu Xun said, “A sound like the whistling spring water in the mountains is soothing enough to be put into words.”
Elder Mei straightened his fat neck, and he glared at Ling Ran in a threatening manner, just like how he would usually look at other people!

“Plump... If he’s plump, you can just delay the surgery for a short while...” Doctor Jin felt a little diffident. The guide did indicate a reduction of fasting time, but that was only for people who were not fat. Doctor Jin racked his brains and said, “Elder Mei actually only ate a little amount of food. If you think about it, he was asked to lose weight in the first half of the month. He also fasted for a long period of time before the surgery. Even a normal person wouldn’t have been able to handle it. You’re now extending the fasting time even further, is it necessary to extend the duration for so long?”
“Yes,” Ling Ran said, “the patient is plump.”
“Enough! Your opinion has been expressed very clearly!” Elder Mei slammed the edge of the bed angrily and wanted to sit up, but he fell down with a tumble instead because his stomach was too big.
His eldest daughter hurried forward and whispered, “Dad, let me help you up.”
“I don’t want to get up!” Elder Mei’s shouted aggressively. “Let me just starve to death!”
Ling Ran corrected him, “Twelve hours of fasting will not kill you.”
“I’ve been hungry since yesterday.”
“Normal individuals will have no problems even if they starve for three days,” Ling Ran said.

“I have more experience than you when it comes to knowing how long a person needs to starve before dying!” Elder Mei grabbed his eldest daughter’s hand and sat up all of a sudden. The sagging flesh on his face was all scrunched up together. “We had to repair the canals and build a dam while we were hungry, but we still had to make sure that we could keep on working. What’s with you? Now that there’s no shortage of food to eat, and I’m no longer running out of clothes to wear, what’s wrong with me eating and drinking a little?”
His eyes were a bit red, but his gaze was still so fierce. He looked like a bear who had just woken up from hibernation.

The eldest daughter grabbed her father’s hand and whispered, “Dad, Doctor Ling isn’t trying to stop you from eating. This is so that he can have a smooth surgery later, and he’s also doing this in consideration of your safety.”
Mei Tiangui also stood out and helped Ling Ran by putting in a few good words for him.
The operation would be performed soon. Right then, no one felt that it was a good idea to scold the chief surgeon.
Elder Mei panted loudly. His rage gradually went away, and his tone became a little better. He said, “Fine. Even if I can’t eat, at least let me drink something.”
“You can drink cola. Carbonated drinks can be drunk three hours before the surgery,” Ling Ran said. “Let’s limit the total to ten ounces.”
Elder Mei’s eyes lit up, but he pouted and said, “Don’t lie to me. Young Jin just said that I can drink two hours before the surgery.”
Ling Ran sighed, and he looked like he was about to give some earnest advice. As he opened his mouth and was about to say something, he was interrupted by Elder Mei.
“I know, I’m plump!” Elder Mei lay flat on the bed out of spite.
Mei Tiangui smoked one cigarette after another at the end of the corridor leading to the operating theaters.
He was almost done smoking a pack of Chunghwa cigarettes when he saw Ling Ran wearing a scrub and entering the operating theater while whispering to a few doctors next to him.
“Doctor Ling, a word with you?” Mei Tiangui crushed the Chunghwa cigarette case, which only had one cigarette left in it.
Ling Ran stood opposite Mei Tiangui, bowed his head, and looked at him quietly.
Mei Tiangui looked at Ling Ran’s face and suddenly felt very pressured.

Mei Tiangui snorted as if he was thinking about something. He placed his hands behind his back, took a few steps to the side, and turned to look at Ling Ran before he said, “Doctor Ling, you’ve performed three operations today, right?”
“Yes.” Ling Ran wore a slight smile. “All three are hepatolithiasis.”
Mei Tiangui nodded slowly. Not only did he know about the three operations that day, but he also knew that dozens of Ling Ran’s similar prior operations had been incredibly successful.

Even if Mei Tiangui did not understand medicine, he understood that while it was easy to promote a surgeon’s successful handling of an operation, it was hard for a surgeon to succeed in every surgery case.

Therefore, although he felt that it may not be the best for Ling Ran to operate on his father after doing three operations before that, if Ling Ran believed that there was no problem, Mei Tiangui had nothing else to say too.
“Doctor Ling, please do your absolute best for my father’s surgery.” Mei Tiangui could only beg with words at that point.
“Okay.” Ling Ran nodded. He looked at Mei Tiangui again before he turned around and said, “We’re going to perform the surgery now.”
“Wait a minute, Doctor Ling, um... is there anything I can do?” Mei Tiangui felt antsy for not being able to help.
“You can just wait,” Ling Ran said.
Mei Tiangui shook his head. “Doctor Ling, we agreed to three things earlier. I mentioned three things, and you did all of them. You requested three things as well, but I couldn’t even fulfil one...”
“Yep.”

“I’ve been feeling uneasy about it the whole time, so I was wondering if there’s something else I can do...” Mei Tiangui said as he looked at Ling Ran. “Please don’t feel like it’s a burden. I-I just want to express my gratitude and regret. I hope that you’ll be happy, and everything will go smoothly...”

“I know.” As Ling Ran listened to Mei Tiangui stuttering, countless similar scenes came to his mind. He did not allow Mei Tiangui to continue feeling awkward, and he waved his hand before he said, “You can ask my team members. If they’re happy, then I’m happy.”
After finishing that sentence, Ling Ran left as Mei Tiangui wore a dumbfounded expression. His team members who were feeling ecstatic went to wash their hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - Simple Request
paragraphs: “Everyone, could we talk?” Mei Tiangui earnestly gestured as an invitation.
Lu Wenbin and the others looked at each other. They dared not leave like Ling Ran so they followed Mei Tiangui to the waiting room on the other end of the corridor.
Doctor Jin was also called over by Mei Tiangui. He sat by the side and eyed everyone with a judgmental gaze.

“Truly, being young is a subject of envy.” Doctor Jin was a proper medical practitioner. He always acted with an air of supremacy that cultured people had when he faced his juniors, and he always possessed the urge to rank them in his mind.
Lu Wenbin and Ma Yanlin could only giggle foolishly.

They were a resident doctor and a houseman in Yun Hua Hospital respectively. They were both considered the type of doctors who could be easily bullied, and they had already gotten used to being bullied.

Yu Yuan was actually about the same too. She was now a chief resident, but she used to be a senior resident doctor. However, to Doctor Jin, who had been a chief physician for a long time, she still faced the destiny of being bullied.
There was no need to even mention Zuo Cidian. He had been bullied since he was young.

Doctor Jin was the exact opposite of them. He graduated from a famous university a long time ago, and he had been famous ever since he was still young. He was valued by the hospital and trusted by patients as well as their families. Then, he got connected with Mei Tiangui, so he had lucrative resources, and no one dared to mess with him...

The term “famous doctors” referred to doctors like Doctor Jin. In their social hierarchy, they were the standard type of people whom others would avoid offending even if they had the power to do so, while those without the power to do so would run far away from them.
Doctor Jin looked at the four of them before he laughed again. “Relax a little. This talk is for all of us to relax.”
Mei Tiangui took out a pack of cigarettes from his bag. He did not light it, but he asked the others, “Do any of you smoke?”
Zuo Cidian was the only one in the Ling Treatment Group who smoked, but he shook his head too.
“Yes, it’s not good to smoke.” Mei Tiangui looked at everyone again. He wore a stern smile. “Let me try to identify all of you. This lady must be Yu Yuan, yes?”
“Yes,” Yu Yuan answered politely like a tame animal.
“This young man looks like he has been going to the gym. You are Doctor Lu, right? You’re Ling Ran’s first assistant?”
“Yes.” Lu Wenbin felt slightly uneasy.
Mei Tiangui identified Zuo Cidian and Ma Yanlin as well before he asked, “Where’s the anaesthetist? Didn’t Doctor Su come along?”
“The anaesthetist will usually go into the operating theater first in order to get prepared.” Doctor Jin stood up and said, “I’ll go and take a look.”
“Okay.” When Mei Tiangui saw that Doctor Jin had left, he played with the cigarette box in his hands. He said, “Actually, I’ve been thinking about appointing a better team to Doctor Ling.”
Four of them were stunned.

“But, Doctor Jin told me that a mature team won’t necessarily be the strongest team. The most suitable team is the most important.” Mei Tiangui’s voice was slow and deep. “The surgeries and the patients who’ve recovered over the past few days have proven that all of you form a mature team.”
Although they knew that he was trying to flatter them, Lu Wenbin and the others still felt slightly excited.
“Doctor Ling is special.” When Mei Tiangui talked about Ling Ran, the sternness of the Mei family lessened slightly.
Four of them nodded gently, and they could not hold their laughter.
Zuo Cidian said, “He’s not just special.”

“Yes, he’s not just special.” Mei Tiangui agreed and nodded. “I consider myself someone who has seen many things, but I really seldom see someone who doesn’t want anything for himself and just wants to share everything with his teammates.”
The four of them were astonished, and their expressions grew more tense.

“I don’t know how all of you communicate with each other usually, but based on what I’ve seen, he truly is a good leader.” Mei Tiangui looked at their expressions and adjusted his words from time to time. For him, it was so easy to merely use words to persuade these young people and Zuo Cidian to do whatever he wanted.
Mei Tiangui had total control of Lu Wenbin and the others’ emotions.

They thought about their medical lives before they met Ling Ran. They thought about how Ling Ran always taught them by tactlessly going straight to the point. They also thought about how Ling Ran was inattentive but still thought about every possibility when he handled things. They also remembered how Ling Ran would go to Yun Hua Hospital and the Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center at three o’clock in the morning. Ling Ran had also gone to the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City and many other hospitals to perform freelance surgeries at three o’clock in the morning...

Mei Tiangui felt like he had formed an adequate foundation. So, he went straight to the point. “If you have any personal requests or thoughts, you can mention them now. I’ll try my best to satisfy your wishes.”
He stressed the words “personal requests” and felt like he had fully stated whatever was summarized during his previous encounter with Ling Ran.

Mei Tiangui looked at the four hesitant doctors and was secretly happy. He said, “I just wanted to express my filialty as a son. Please don’t feel burdened about that. In fact, I’m here to help reduce some of your burden.”
Four of them looked at each other and did not know what to say.
“Doctor Yu, ladies first. Why don’t you say whatever you want first?” Mei Tiangui said her name and looked at Yu Yuan eagerly.
Deep down, Mei Tiangui actually loved to satisfy other people’s wishes.
It was especially so when he did not need to spend much to fulfill someone’s lifelong wish. He would feel a great sense of accomplishment from it.
Yu Yuan was slightly bashful as she said, “I have no requests.”

“Just name it. All humans must have some dreams or wishes, right?” Mei Tiangui’s stern face had now become gentler. With a nostalgic tone, he smiled and said, “Just like me, when I was young, the thing I wanted to do the most was to sit in a fighter plane. After that, I had an uncle who brought me to sit on a trainer. That feeling was...”
Mei Tiangui gasped in amazement.

“I’d like to go to a few national conservation areas and collect some things. Um... I’ll be touching some plants, animals, and insects. I’ll just collect some residue samples.” Yu Yuan knew this opportunity was hard to come by. She gathered her courage and voiced her request.
Mei Tiangui laughed out loud. “Miss Yu, you like nature? Okay, that’s simple to handle. But what do you mean by collecting residue?”
“Mainly biological waste,” Yu Yuan said.
“Like dead twigs and amber?”
“It’s a bit different,” Yu Yuan said.
“You need to be more detailed, or else others will keep questioning you about it.” Mei Tiangui waved his hand and called in a subordinate who had been waiting outside.
The young man took out his notebook and started to take notes seriously.
Yu Yuan hesitated slightly and said, “I want to collect animal feces.”
“Hmm?” Mei Tiangui’s hands stopped toying with the cigarette box.
“It doesn’t have to be fresh,” Yu Yuan quickly added. “Old fecal samples will be okay as well. It’s not dangerous.”
“Hmm...” Mei Tiangui turned away and said to that young man, “You’ll have to ask the related departments.”
The young man looked stunned. He was holding a pen, and he looked foolish. ‘Is there any department that works with feces?’

“Does that mean you’re okay with it?” Yu Yuan became excited and thanked him. Then, she said, “I submitted an application to the Forestry Department in the past, but it was rejected directly. I was even treated as someone crazy...”
The subordinate smiled politely. He made an assessment in his heart, ‘Our Forestry Department is still quite reliable.’
Mei Tiangui’s expression also changed in a similar manner. He no longer had a fierce face or tried try to remember his past again. He seemed bewildered and shocked.
A few seconds later, Mei Tiangui pretended to forget Yu Yuan’s existence. His sight shifted upward, and he looked at Lu Wenbin before he said, “Doctor Lu, what about you?”
Doctor Lu stared at Yu Yuan, and the hope in his heart suddenly increased.
‘If Yu Yuan’s crazy request could be fulfilled, my request would be even simpler! Maybe he would even go the extra mile to fulfill my request!’
Lu Wenbin looked at Mei Tiangui and the subordinate beside him. He said eagerly, “I want to get married!”
Mei Tiangui cast Lu Wenbin a profound glance.
Lu Wenbin’s face was full of smiles.

Mei Tiangui actually had many questions to ask. But in the end, Mei Tiangui set aside all his feelings and thoughts. He said to Doctor Lu Wenbin, who was about to serve as the first assistant in his father’s surgery. “Let me arrange some blind dates for you.”
Lu Wenbin quickly nodded. “I like the ones with big butts and who love the gym. It’s okay if her breasts are big.”
The subordinate who was recording everything in a daze while holding his notebook also had hope blooming slowly in his heart. ‘So, can I ask the organization to get me a wife too?’
“Doctor Zuo?” Mei Tiangui looked at Zuo Cidian, who was the oldest. He wanted to catch his breath slightly.
Zuo Cidian had been waiting for quite a while. “I want to help my son transfer to a new school.”
Mei Tiangui sighed in relief. He quickly said to his subordinate next to him, “Write that down.”
For him, helping people change jobs or change schools was a basic operation.
The subordinate also felt slightly relieved. If the new school was not too troublesome and stubborn, he could still get it done.
“Doctor Zuo, which school do you want to have your child transferred to? Which school is he studying in now?” The subordinate wanted to think about the difficulty of the request.
Zuo Cidian remained silent for a while before he said, “I don’t know.”
“Hmm? Then, what do you require?”
“I actually don’t require much. I just want a more responsible school that can improve my son’s grades...” Zuo Cidian bent his waist humbly.
“Anything else?” Mei Tiangui nodded gently to show encouragement. After he heard about so many crazy requests from the doctors, he felt so happy to hear such a simple and straightforward request.

Zuo Cidian knew how to observe people’s faces. He immediately realized that he could still request more from Mei Tiangui as Mei Tiangui had not stopped him. At that moment, Zuo Cidian thought of basketball, soccer, swimming, fencing, tennis, and golf. He also thought of piano, violin, sketching, painting, and Spanish lessons...
However, Zuo Cidian’s careful personality prevented him from saying those words.

“It’ll be enough as long as he has a place to study quietly. My ex-wife doesn’t know how to bring up our son too, so we need the school teachers to give him more attention,” Zuo Cidian answered honestly.
Mei Tiangui secretly sighed in relief. ‘That’s right. That’s how a normal doctor should act.’
Mei Tiangui nodded and agreed to his request. Then, he looked at Ma Yanlin.
Houseman Ma Yanlin smiled brightly.
The flabby flesh on Mei Tiangui’s face became softer. ‘A doctor who smiles so brightly would raise a normal request, right?!’
